assets.label: Sand Mauler — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create a NEW original alien riding animal design for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse, not a claimed canonical creature. Exactly TWO full-body SIDE profile drawings SIDE BY SIDE, left drawing facing RIGHT, right drawing facing LEFT. Same anatomy and scale in separately drawn opposing sides. Entire silhouette inside each half with generous MAGENTA #FF00FF blank margins, no cropping. Detailed painted game bitmap. No environment, ground shadow, labels, text, borders, rider, saddle, harness, armor, chains or effects. Bare creature base layer. Distinct limb roots and separated feet, physically plausible joints. Desert mount with EXACTLY SIX legs in three pairs, each pair attached at its own shoulder/rib/hip station. Long low ochre reptilian body, thick sandy granular hide, broad shovel-like claw feet splayed for dunes, long counterbalancing tail, blunt armored crocodile-like skull with lateral sensory pits to detect buried movement. Six feet visibly staggered at distinct horizontal positions, no missing middle far leg, no seventh leg. Slightly elevated side camera only enough to expose the far three legs. No tentacles or dorsal spikes.
notes: Identité en revue ; nombre de membres, appuis et détails à contrôler. Selle, cavalier et effets indépendants à produire.
Inspection visuelle finale : chaque vue ne présente que cinq pieds sur les six imposés ; la patte médiane opposée est absente. Rejet anatomique, aucun clip runtime accepté.
